create_knowledge_base: create a knowledge base with a name, description, and optional access control settings
search_knowledge_bases: search knowledge bases by query string and view option with pagination
add_file_to_knowledge: add a processed file to a knowledge base and embed it in the vector database
reindex_knowledge_files: reindex all knowledge bases by deleting and re-embedding their file contents
export_knowledge_base: export a knowledge base as a zip file containing all its file contents as .txt files
